description: This file defines the IRemoteSiloProber interface, which specifies methods for probing remote silos for responsiveness within Orleans' runtime membership service. It includes methods for direct and indirect probing, facilitating health checks and fault detection of silos in a distributed system.
external_methods: Task<IndirectProbeResponse> ProbeIndirectly(SiloAddress, SiloAddress, TimeSpan, int, CancellationToken)

methods.name: Probe
methods.description: Probes a specific silo for responsiveness asynchronously.

methods.name: ProbeIndirectly
methods.description: Probes a target silo indirectly through an intermediary, with a specified timeout.

calls: Task<IndirectProbeResponse> ProbeIndirectly(SiloAddress, SiloAddress, TimeSpan, int, CancellationToken)
